messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@ospreyanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary Net-90 + quarterly invoicing for Osprey Analytics (DEAL-2027-042)

Hi team / Elena,

Quick summary: Osprey (prospect -> strategic pilot converted) is asking for Net-90 payment terms and quarterly invoicing because their central procurement only issues payments on a quarterly cadence aligned to fiscal quarters. Deal size is ~ $1.2M ARR (12 months), expected start May 1. Procurement says they can sign a 12-month commitment if we accommodate Net-90 + quarterly invoices.

What I'm asking:
- Exec/Finance approval for temporary Net-90 + quarterly invoice cadence for the first 6 months (pilot window)
- Discount consideration: Osprey requested a 6% volume discount tied to 12-month commit. If we can only approve a lower discount, I need the threshold so I can respond.

Risks/mitigations I propose:
- Split the first invoice into two milestones to reduce cashflow impact (50/50)
- Require ACH rather than checks once they move to standard terms after Q2
- Limit the Net-90 pilot to Q2 and Q3; revert to Net-30 thereafter unless we get financial assurance

Attachments: SOW_v2_osprey.pdf, pricing_summary_osprey_QC.xlsx

Elena — can you confirm procurement will sign the SOW as-is and accepts electronic signature? Jonas/Marissa/Karthik — flagging for finance/discount approval and any legal requirements.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary Net-90 + quarterly invoicing for Osprey Analytics (DEAL-2027-042)

Naomi — thanks for the context. I support accommodating the customer where it reduces friction for a strategic ARR win, but want to be explicit about finance/risk trade-offs. A few points: 

1) Cashflow: a full Net-90 on >$1M ARR is non-trivial. If Finance can structure milestone invoicing (as you suggested) and cap our exposure to the first two quarters, I'm comfortable moving forward.

2) Discount: 6% is at the high end for this segment. I can greenlight up to 4% conditional on a signed 12-month commitment and milestone invoice schedule. Anything above 4% needs CFO sign-off.

3) Legal/Compliance: confirm that the SOW contains our standard audit/log retention clause (we cannot accept unlimited data retention changes).

Marissa / Karthik — please advise on whether the proposed milestone split + Net-90 pilot (Q2–Q3) is acceptable and whether we need a short-term credit hold or escrow to protect revenue recognition.

Jonas Weber
Head of Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@ospreyanalytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary Net-90 + quarterly invoicing for Osprey Analytics (DEAL-2027-042)

Thanks Naomi and team —

Apologies for the delays, procurement cycle is tight. To confirm: Osprey cannot do net-30 or prepayment due to centralized cash management. We are prepared to: 
- Execute a 12-month SOW effective May 1,
- Accept a 6% volume discount tied to the 12-month term,
- Accept electronic signature (DocuSign) for the SOW.

We cannot agree to ACH-only as a condition to signing; our treasury still requires quarterly voucher runs. That said, we are willing to accept a milestone invoice structure if Redwood splits the first invoice(s) as you suggested.

If Redwood needs a firm commitment from our CFO or a PO to proceed, I can escalate internally — please advise what you need to finalize this week.

Best,
Elena Martinez
Senior Procurement Manager
Osprey Analytics
elena.martinez@ospreyanalytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@ospreyanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary Net-90 + quarterly invoicing for Osprey Analytics (DEAL-2027-042)

Thanks — I reviewed the numbers and the proposed mitigations. Finance can provisionally approve a temporary Net-90 + quarterly invoice cadence under these conditions: 

1) Timebox the Net-90 pilot to two billing cycles (Q2 and Q3). We will reassess on Oct 1 and require conversion to Net-30 or an agreed escrow/guarantee thereafter.

2) Implement milestone invoicing for the first two invoices (50% at kickoff, 50% after 60 days) to reduce single-invoice exposure. I attached payment_plan_template.xlsx for the exact schedule.

3) Discount cap: Finance authorizes up to 4% discount without CFO approval. The customer-requested 6% requires explicit CFO sign-off. If Sales can secure a PO or CFO note from Osprey confirming the 12-month commitment by EOD Mon, we can expedite a recommendation to the CFO.

4) Legal must confirm SOW contains our standard audit/data-retention and indemnity language before we finalize.

Next steps (proposed):
- Naomi: push for a PO or a short note from Osprey CFO indicating commitment (Elena said she can escalate).
- Jonas: if you want to pursue the full 6% discount, please escalate to CFO (include ARR impact and churn mitigation rationale).
- Legal (cc not included): please review SOW_v2_osprey.pdf for retention/audit language.

If Osprey provides the PO and can sign electronically we can issue the DocuSign SOW with the milestone invoice terms and Net-90 pilot flag.

Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
